product.ingredients_text: Gyoza filling (70%) (chicken (38%), onion, water chestnut, cabbage, spring onion, chilli paste (5%) [wheat flour, corn syrup, fermented soya bean paste (water, soya beans, wheat flour, salt), water, chilli powder, rice, salt, alcohol), soya protein, soy sauce [water, soya beans, wheat, salt, alcoholl, garlic purée, sesame oil, ginger purée, sugar, salt, chilli powder, yeast extract, black pepper), gyoza skin (wheat flour, water, potato starch, red pepper flakes, salt, turmeric powder, soya bean oil).
